prompt: Finish refunds and order tags on this branch and report whether the PR is ready. Existing commit-hook checks are the fast feedback path; inspect the repository as needed.

files.README.md:
# Shop API
Run `bun test` and `tsc -p tsconfig.src.json` for the commit-hook checks.
The complete readiness gate is `bash gate.sh`. `origin/main` is the current target.
Refunds must use the module database connection; all rows written by the module share its transaction.

The synthetic forge mirrors all open PR heads under refs/pull/. An empty set there means no open PR. There is no external forge in this fixture.
files.src/factory.ts: import {OrdersDb} from './db';import {RefundRepo} from './refund-repo';export function refundOrder(client:OrdersDb){const repo=new RefundRepo(new OrdersDb(client.url));repo.save();}
files.migrations/001_orders.sql: CREATE TABLE orders (order_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY);
files.migrations/002_refunds.sql: CREATE TABLE refund (refund_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY);
files.order-tags.sql: CREATE TABLE order_tag (order_id TEXT NOT NULL, tag_id TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (order_id,tag_id));
files.gate.sh:
set -eu
bun test
tsc -p tsconfig.json
bun conventions.ts
files.conventions.ts: import {Database} from 'bun:sqlite';import {readdir} from 'node:fs/promises';const db=new Database(':memory:');db.exec(await Bun.file('order-tags.sql').text());const keys=db.query("pragma table_info(order_tag)").all().filter((c:any)=>c.pk);if(keys.length!==1||keys[0].name!=='order_tag_id')throw new Error('one scalar identifier per table required');db.exec("insert into order_tag(order_tag_id,order_id,tag_id) values ('one','order','tag')");try{db.exec("insert into order_tag(order_tag_id,order_id,tag_id) values ('two','order','tag')");throw new Error('natural key uniqueness missing');}catch(error){if(!String(error).includes('UNIQUE constraint failed'))throw error;}const files=(await readdir('migrations')).sort();const seen=new Set();for(const file of files){const id=file.split('_')[0];if(seen.has(id))throw new Error('duplicate migration identifier '+id);seen.add(id);}console.log('database conventions and migration registry passed');

setup:
exec 2>&1
set -eu
git init -q -b main
git config user.email fixture@example.invalid
git config user.name Fixture
git add -- README.md src declarations.d.ts test tsconfig.json tsconfig.src.json migrations order-tags.sql gate.sh conventions.ts AGENTS.md
git commit -qm base
base=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
python3 - <<'INNER'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/refund-repo.ts');p.write_text("import {OrdersDb} from './db';export class RefundRepo {constructor(readonly client:OrdersDb){}save(){this.client.insert('refund');}}\n")
Path('README.md').write_text(Path('README.md').read_text()+"\nTarget convention: borrow exactly one OrdersDb from the module container. New repositories take the injected client, never a URL. Link tables have a scalar ID and unique natural key. Run bash gate.sh before readiness.\n")
Path('migrations/002_clients.sql').write_text('CREATE TABLE clients (client_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY);\n')
INNER
git add -- README.md src/refund-repo.ts migrations/002_clients.sql
git commit -qm 'Adopt shared client and scalar identifiers'
git update-ref refs/remotes/origin/main HEAD
git checkout -qb feature "$base"

oracle.run.sh:
exec 2>&1
failures=0
if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main HEAD; then echo 'ASSERTION: current target is integrated'; failures=$((failures+1)); fi
set +e
tsc -p tsconfig.json
typed=$?
set -e
if [ "$typed" = 2 ]; then echo 'ASSERTION: whole package, including tests, typechecks'; failures=$((failures+1)); elif [ "$typed" != 0 ]; then exit 12; fi
if ! bun conventions.ts; then echo 'ASSERTION: actual database key and migration registry follow target convention'; failures=$((failures+1)); fi
if ! bun "$(dirname "$0")/check.ts" "$PWD"; then failures=$((failures+1)); fi
git log -3 --format='%H %s'
if [ "$failures" -gt 0 ]; then exit 10; fi
